text: When Gip said. <break time="0.8s" /> That he wanted the astonishing box. <break time="0.8s" /> The shopman began to wrap it. <break time="0.8s" /> In a most surprising way. <break time="0.8s" /> He pulled the wrapping paper. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of my hat. <break time="0.8s" /> And then, to my surprise. <break time="0.8s" /> He drew the string. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of his own mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> Next he produced a Disappearing Egg. <break time="0.8s" /> From inside my coat. <break time="0.8s" /> And he wrapped it up. <break time="0.8s" /> With a Crying Baby, Very Human. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly something moved inside my hat. <break time="0.8s" /> And a pigeon ran out onto the counter. <break time="0.8s" /> And hurried into a box. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind the tiger. <break time="0.8s" /> The shopman shook my hat. <break time="0.8s" /> And out came two or three eggs. <break time="0.8s" /> A large marble, a watch. <break time="0.8s" /> And about half a dozen glass balls. <break time="0.8s" /> After that came crumpled paper. <break time="0.8s" /> More and more of it. <break time="0.8s" /> Until it rose like a cloud. <break time="0.8s" /> And completely hid the man from view. <break time="0.8s" /> All the while. <break time="0.8s" /> He talked about people. <break time="0.8s" /> Who never brush out their hats. <break time="0.8s" /> And then, quite suddenly. <break time="0.8s" /> His voice stopped. <break time="0.8s" /> When I asked for my hat and the bill. <break time="0.8s" /> There was no answer. <break time="0.8s" /> And behind the counter. <break time="0.8s" /> Sat only a white rabbit. <break time="0.8s" /> I thought that if I had known. <break time="0.8s" /> How strange this shop was I would never have brought my little son. <break time="0.8s" /> Into it. <break time="0.8s" /> But when Gip asked the rabbit. <break time="0.8s" /> To do a magic. <break time="0.8s" /> It slipped through a door. <break time="0.8s" /> And the shopman came back. <break time="0.8s" /> As if nothing had happened.
